title: I-75 road-rage firearm incident involving Jordan Patascher

data.name: I-75 road-rage firearm incident
data.description: Hillsborough County investigators said Jordan Patascher threatened another driver and displayed/pointed a handgun during a road-rage encounter on southbound I-75 near the U.S. 301 exit. Victim identity intentionally omitted.

geospatial.notes: Approximate location anchored to Exit 254 because public reporting says the incident occurred near the U.S. 301 exit.

temporal.precision: reported as shortly before 6:30 p.m. local time
